title: Declarative "at most one row per parent where X" (conditional unique) — summary-based guards miss rows in the same bulk insert
body:
Ruled: 6377847361 · batch #9 item 4 · letter C · 2026-10-24T00:43:45Z (proposal 3: batch-aware summary, in-memory per batch; proposals 1 and 2 not now)

## Context

hotsrm needs "each supplier has at most one primary contact" (`srm_supplier_contact.is_primary`). It must hold for UI edits and for the spreadsheet import, metadata only.

## What we tried

- `indexes[].partial` is retired, and a unique index on `['supplier', 'is_primary']` would also forbid two non-primary contacts.
- A summary on the parent (`primary_contact_count`, count with `filter: { is_primary: true }`) plus a `script` rule on the child: `record.is_primary == true && record.supplier.primary_contact_count > 0`. This catches a second primary when the first already exists, **but not two primary rows created in the same import batch**: the import runner batches creates through `createManyData` / `insertManyData`, and the parent summary is not recomputed between the rows of one batch, so both rows pass.

Reproduction: import `供应商,姓名,邮箱,主联系人` with two rows for a new supplier, both `是` → both created, `primary_contact_count = 2`.

## Proposal

One of:

1. ~~Conditional unique index: `{ fields: ['supplier'], unique: 'organization', where: { is_primary: true } }` (partial index on SQL drivers, emulated on memory).~~ (not now — re-opens the key retired in #5248; its entry stays #5248's enforce-first condition, on a second app or a real incident; ruling 6377847361)
2. ~~A declarative cross-row rule type (`type: 'unique_where'` or similar) that is judged per row inside bulk writes.~~ (not chosen; ruling 6377847361)
3. At minimum: evaluate child `script` rules that read a parent summary against a summary that includes earlier rows of the same batch, or document that they do not.

## Workaround in hotsrm (temporary)

The summary-based guard stays (it covers single writes and later imports), and a list view "主联系人重复" (`primary_contact_count > 1`) surfaces the batch case for manual repair during review.

Linked: objectstack-ai/hotsrm#10
